trust_decision.summary: coderd/aibridgedserver.IsAuthorized decides whether an API key (full key, or a bare key ID on the delegated in-process path) may use the AI Bridge LLM proxy; it required an existing unexpired key with a matching secret owned by a non-deleted, non-system user, but never required the user to be active, so suspended/dormant owners kept proxy access.

landing_point.why: The deleted/system-user block inside IsAuthorized is the only place that reads as 'the proxy's authorizer'; the report's symptom (suspended users still proxied) points straight at the user checks there.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST|GET /api/v2/aibridge/{provider}/* (enterprise/coderd/aibridge.go:76-95 -> coderd/aibridged/http.go:131 -> DRPC Authorizer.IsAuthorized); also the in-process delegated transport (coderd/aibridged/transport.go:62-119)

POST|GET /api/v2/aibridge/{provider}/* (enterprise/coderd/aibridge.go:76-95 -> coderd/aibridged/http.go:131 -> DRPC Authorizer.IsAuthorized); also the in-process delegated transport (coderd/aibridged/transport.go:62-119)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route exist; the nearest arguable edge is the delegated in-process branch, where a solver could claim chatd's transport already sits behind the chat API's active-user middleware and needs no re-check (coderd/aibridge/factory.go:36-41 states that contract), yet the published fix covers it inside the same function.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Dormant accounts are legitimately reactivated on first authenticated use (ActivateDormantUser turns dormant -> active); a fix that treats 'not active' as one undifferentiated rejection at a shared layer, or that conflates dormant with suspended across auth code, breaks that reactivation path.

O6_input_shapes: full API key 'id-secret' supplied as Authorization: Bearer, X-Api-Key, or X-Coder-AI-Governance-Token
bare key ID (KeyId field, delegated in-process callers that never hold the secret)
any other non-active status value (the check is a negated equality against active)

O7_producer.where: coderd/users.go:1021-1026 (UpdateUserStatus inside putUserStatus, reached from PUT /api/v2/users/{user}/status/suspend|activate); the check reads the persisted users row via GetUserByID at coderd/aibridgedserver/aibridgedserver.go:620, so no serialization/cache boundary is crossed

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an active-user check in GetMCPServerAccessTokensBatch before handing out the user's external-auth OAuth tokens
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same dRPC server, same AIBridged authz context, and the method already takes a bare UserId from the internal caller; a maintainer fixing 'suspended users keep AI access' would plausibly harden it in the same commit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: enforce the delegated-identity contract (caller must have proven the owner may act) at the in-process transport boundary instead of in IsAuthorized
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the transport already fails fast on a missing delegated key ID, so the natural place for the next invariant is right beside it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: gate AI Gateway routing on the chat owner's account status before stamping the delegated API key ID
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: chatd stamps the active turn's key ID here for every model call, and a chat run can outlive the suspension that should have stopped it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second copy of the user-status policy at the MITM CONNECT edge
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: authMiddleware already parses the Coder token from Proxy-Authorization and rejects on missing/invalid credentials; a maintainer could have added a status lookup there instead of relying on coderd.

O9_family: incorrect authorization (CWE-863): API-key authorizer omits the account-state predicate

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26.4 per go.mod; standard `go build ./...` / `go test ./coderd/aibridgedserver/...`; no code generation needed for this area
services: postgres (enterprise integration tests such as enterprise/aibridged_integration_test.go only; the fix's own unit tests use gomock and need no services)
O10_build.project_tests: coderd/aibridgedserver/aibridgedserver_test.go: TestAuthorization (full key) and TestAuthorization_Delegated (KeyId), both table-driven over a gomock store with no DB and no network; the published fix extends both tables with 'suspended user' and 'dormant user' cases.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the advisory title and add `if user.Status == database.UserStatusSuspended { return ErrInactiveUser }` next to the deleted-user check, leaving dormant (and any future non-active) owners able to keep proxying.

out_of_scope_notes: GetMCPServerAccessTokensBatch (coderd/aibridgedserver/aibridgedserver.go:461-479) trusts a caller-supplied UserId and returns that user's external-auth OAuth access tokens with no user lookup or status check at all; adjacent to this advisory's mechanism but a different protected resource, so not pursued.
